app.name: CivicLens AI
app.notice: Academic prototype — not an official government portal.

preview.title: A clearer lens on civic workflows.
preview.lead: A shared visual foundation for multilingual civic intelligence—where AI recommends, people decide, and every decision stays accountable.
preview.positioningBody: CivicLens adds an intelligence and accountability layer to existing complaint workflows. It does not replace the services people already use.
preview.intelligence: Understand → Extract → Classify → Prioritise → Route → Detect related issues → Monitor SLA → Escalate → Verify resolution → Audit AI decisions
preview.principlesTitle: Trust is part of the interface.
preview.aiRecommendsBody: Recommendations show an estimated confidence, plain-language reason, and model version. Low confidence is sent for human review.
preview.originalSacredBody: The citizen’s exact text is preserved. Normalised text is a separate, clearly identified derived value.
preview.citizenVerificationBody: Staff submit a proposed resolution. Only the citizen can accept it; rejection reopens the case and records a reason.
preview.auditableBody: The append-only audit history records original AI values, human changes, reasons, actor, and time.
preview.tokensTitle: One foundation. Light, dark, and RTL.
preview.tokensBody: Switch themes and direction to check the palette, typography, spacing, depth, and motion before building product screens.
preview.typeUrduBody: شہری کی شکایت کو سمجھیں اور واضح جواب دیں۔
preview.typeRomanBody: Gali mein pani jama hai, barah-e-karam madad karein.
preview.typeRomanNote: Roman Urdu remains ordinary left-to-right Latin text.
preview.motionHint: Motion respects reduced-motion preferences and animates transform or opacity.
preview.sampleCardBody: A shared card shows surface, border, radius, depth, and readable contrast.

marketingGallery.sectionLead: Reusable marketing surfaces for explaining how CivicLens understands, prioritises, and supports civic workflows.
marketingGallery.statsLead: Examples use demo data for interface preview only; they are not measured system results.
marketingGallery.cardsHeadline: A clearer way to explain the system.
marketingGallery.cardsLead: Each card accepts its icon, copy, label, and optional link as props.
marketingGallery.featureText: Preserve the citizen’s words while extracting the details needed for review.
marketingGallery.pillarText: AI recommendations support decisions; authorised people make them.
marketingGallery.serviceText: Summarise the issue and suggest a relevant department for human review.
marketingGallery.recognitionText: Show the recommendation, its estimated confidence, and the reason behind it.
marketingGallery.darkLead: The on-dark variants keep text, icons, and demo labels distinct against a deep background.

marketingShowcase.stepsLead: AI recommendations add context to existing civic workflows while people remain in control.
marketingShowcase.understandText: Read the citizen’s original report in its own words.
marketingShowcase.extractText: Identify issue details and preserve the original alongside derived fields.
marketingShowcase.classifyText: Estimate category and urgency, with a reason for human review.
marketingShowcase.routeText: Recommend a department; an authorised person confirms the decision.
marketingShowcase.faqLead: A brief overview of the prototype’s role and boundaries.
marketingShowcase.faqQuestionOne: Does CivicLens replace existing complaint portals?
marketingShowcase.faqAnswerOne: No. It is an academic prototype exploring an intelligence and accountability layer for existing workflows.
marketingShowcase.faqQuestionTwo: Does AI make the final decision?
marketingShowcase.faqAnswerTwo: No. AI provides recommendations and estimates; authorised people review and decide.
marketingShowcase.faqQuestionThree: Are the statistics shown measured results?
marketingShowcase.faqAnswerThree: No. Any sample figures are marked as demo data and do not represent evaluation results.
marketingShowcase.ctaHeadline: Make every recommendation easier to review.
marketingShowcase.ctaBody: Explore how explainable suggestions can support accountable civic workflows.
marketingShowcase.imageHeadline: A clearer view of every civic report.
marketingShowcase.imageBody: Preserve the original words, add useful context, and keep people responsible for decisions.
marketingShowcase.phoneBody: A short, reviewable summary based on the submitted report.
marketingShowcase.orbsTitle: A calm space for better decisions.
marketingShowcase.orbsBody: Soft ambient motion supports the story without competing with its content.
